title: Afternoon Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Afternoon Sunwatch — November 07, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Moderate (C1.2)
🔥 Latest solar flare: M1.9 (Peaked November 07, 2026 at 18:42 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 643 km/s (Fast)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Unsettled (Kp 3.00)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Geomagnetic K-index of 5

Sunny's watching that M-Class flare! The solar wind is in a hurry today. 💥🌬💣🌌

Several bright active regions and a broad dark coronal structure are visible on today’s Sun, while the coronagraph shows no clear large outward feature.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 131 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
